title: Measurement summary
responsibility: Groups applicable size and performance facts in one entity performance profile with consistently sized rows. Overview shows one scalar latency and matching-workload memory value with equal-height size and complexity rows; detailed tables stay in Details.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared size and performance rows including emitted target identity, notes, environment, tolerance and over-policy flags.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True hides inline size notes while retaining their tooltips.

outputs.name: EntitySummary
outputs.description: One Performance profile card with equal-height label/value rows. Output-size rows with target none are omitted; real target sizes and unavailable reasons remain visible. Workload profiles stay separate and supplied tolerance flags remain visible.
